briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Cracks $17B in Lifetime Sales as Psilocybin Nears the Finish Line Nationally
briefs.top: Michigan's legal market just crossed a historic $17 billion in cumulative sales even as operators keep fighting the 24% wholesale tax — and now a GOP gubernatorial nominee is courting industry cash with a repeal pledge. Nationally, Compass Pathways' psilocybin therapy is racing toward an FDA decision while medical marijuana's Schedule III status just survived a court challenge, adding fuel to a record $20B sales year.

local.text: Michigan tops $17 billion in lifetime cannabis sales
local.text_full: Michigan tops $17 billion in lifetime cannabis sales — the CRA's new monthly report shows the state has generated an estimated $2.66 billion in state excise and sales taxes since legalization.
